messages:
kelsey: Heads up — during the private-controlplane deploy at 09:12 UTC we saw an automated RBAC rollback to commit df9a2c3. A couple on‑prem admin accounts lost 'admin:full' role and couldn't reach the control plane. VPC allowlist unchanged. :eyes:

devin: Logs? any audit events for policy.apply or rollback? can we see who triggered it?

security-bot: Alert: policy.rollback detected for namespace=redwood-controlplane, policy=rbac/roles-v2, actor=deploy-bot, commit=df9a2c3. Evidence: https://internal.logs/policy/1912345678 (automated)

kelsey: Pasted the relevant audit snippet:
```
{ "event": "policy.apply", "actor": "deploy-bot", "commit": "df9a2c3", "change": "replaced role binding admin:full -> admin:limited" }
```
We didn't manually run anything.

maria: Could be the role-name normalization bug from last refactor — migration script renamed admin:full -> admin_full in some envs. Check KMS key bindings too; if the key policy changed the controlplane couldn't decrypt secrets and fallback applied older policy. :lock:

aj: I'll try reapplying the intended binding from S3:
```
kubectl apply -f s3://rbac-manifests/private/controlplane/admin-full-binding.yaml
```
If that works we'll patch the deployer's migration step.

samir: I filed an incident INC-482 and added runbook link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-482 — tagging oncall. Please add timeline entries.

devin: Reapplied binding, verified access for two affected onprem-admin users. Also pushed hotfix to the migration: add explicit alias mapping admin_full -> admin:full and add a guard to fail the deploy if any binding names mismatch. PR: https://repo/pulls/3912 :thumbsup:

maria: Also rotated the KMS key policy back to allow the controlplane service account to decrypt secrets (was an unintended deny in policy_v2). Added a test in the e2e that simulates KMS-deny and fails build. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: Incident INC-482 updated: status=resolved, resolution=role-binding reapplied + migration hardening + KMS policy rollback. Postmortem requested.

kelsey: Thanks all. Next steps — write a short postmortem (owner: kelsey), add an alert for policy.rollback events in PagerDuty, and run a one-off audit to enumerate all envs for role_name drift. I'll start the postmortem draft.

devin: For the audit, query:
```
SELECT env, role, COUNT(*) FROM rbac_bindings GROUP BY env, role HAVING role NOT LIKE '%:%'
```
That should catch any missing colon variants.

maria: Assigned follow-ups in INC-482 for KMS review and add alert rules. Will pair with aj tomorrow. :calendar:

kelsey: Closing thread here, continuing discussion in the incident doc. Thanks :heart:
